verdict.rationale: A community report describes GitLab's own GitHub importer as bringing over repo data, issues, pull requests, review comments, wikis, milestones, labels and release notes, while preserving cross-references and visibility. That covers every element of the story. Third-party migration partners (Relokia, Unito) are not counted as the product's own capability. missing for 10: first-party importer documentation, evidence of importers for hosting platforms other than GitHub, explicit coverage of review approvals/states beyond review comments.
